instruction: Chrome is opening funbrain.com on startup. Change the startup page to google.com instead.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

scoring_breakdown.google_startup: 1.0 - restore_on_startup==4 AND startup_urls contains google.com AND no funbrain

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome Preferences file to extract restore_on_startup and startup_urls — the exact fields needed to verify startup configuration.
Metric checks all three required conditions: restore_on_startup == 4 (specific pages mode), google.com present in startup_urls, and funbrain.com absent from startup_urls.
Full instruction coverage: the task requires replacing funbrain.com with google.com, and the metric verifies both the addition of google.com and the removal of funbrain.com.
Negative control resistance: the initial state (restore_on_startup=4, startup_urls=['http://funbrain.com/']) correctly returns 0.0 because funbrain is present and google is absent.
File-based state does not depend on dialog or UI state, so no postconfig is needed — the getter can read the Preferences file at evaluation time.
URL substring matching ('google.com' in url.lower()) is flexible enough to match https://google.com, www.google.com, etc.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The metric's `expected` parameter (containing expected_url: 'google.com') is unused — the expected URL is hardcoded. This is acceptable for this task but reduces reusability.
